xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: Notes: (i) The financial results were reviewed by Audit Committee and approved by Board of Directors of the Company at meeting held on 06/11/2023. The limited review for quarter ended 30/09/2023, as required under Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, has been carried out by Statutory Auditors. (ii) The Consolidated financial results reflect results of Linde India Ltd (Parent Company) and share of profit of one of Joint venture 'Linde South Asia Services Pvt Ltd'. In consolidated financial results, considering terms and conditions of shareholding agreements(SHAs) of three associates namely Avaada MHYavat Pvt Ltd, FP Solar Shakti Pvt Ltd & FPEL Surya Pvt Ltd, in accordance with Ind AS, the Company is not required to apply equity method of accounting. Also, in respect of one Joint Venture (namely Bellary Oxygen Company Pvt Ltd), the Company is not required to apply equity method of accounting as this is classified as 'Investments held for Sale'. (iii) Certain Shareholders have raised objections on related party transactions entered into by Linde India Ltd ( Company ) with Praxair India Pvt Ltd and Linde South Asia Services Pvt Ltd since resolution on material related party transactions in 85th AGM held on 24/06/2021 had been rejected by shareholders. The Company has also received inquiries and information requests from SEBI in connection with certain related party transactions and arrangements to which Company has been responding. Based on legal opinion obtained by Company, the Company is in compliance with all requirements under the SEBI (LODR) Regulations 2015 in respect of all related party transactions entered into by it. No related party transaction entered into by the Company has a value in excess of the materiality threshold of 10% or more of the annual consolidated turnover of Company. Therefore, there are no material related party transactions entered into by the Company. In terms of legal opinion obtained by the Company, it has applied materiality threshold of 10% or more of the annual consolidated turnover of the Company to the value of each of the related party transactions and not by aggregating the value of all related party transactions it has entered into and ascertained that no shareholder approval is required for any related party transaction in terms of Regulation 23 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (LODR) Regulations 2015, which is not “material” in nature. In October 2023, SEBI summoned the Managing Director and the Secretary of the Company to appear before its Investigating Authority (“IA”) on 07/11/2023 and has also summoned the Company to furnish certain information and documents by 19/11/2023 in support of its investigation into financial information and business transactions of the Company where they believe there is a reasonable ground to believe that the disclosure of financial information and the business transactions have been dealt with in a manner which may be detrimental to investors or the securities markets; and/or an intermediary or person associated with the securities market and may have violated the provisions of the Securities Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 or Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 or SEBI (PFUTP) Regulations, 2003 or SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The Company will cooperate fully with the IA and will share necessary information and documents in due course of the investigation. The Company reserves the right to seek appropriate legal remedies as may be legally advised. Management regularly evaluates the business and regulatory risks, including the above matters and it recognises the related uncertainties around their ultimate outcomes, the impact of which, if any, is not presently ascertainable.
